text: Hong Ying holds an uncanny affinity for the Wind of Yin, and the ink-jade flames upon his blade are its finest conduit — rising and reshaping whenever he must channel the winds of magic or strike down a foe.

Jade Blood Rune Art is a unique technique developed by the Jade Blood Taoists to harness the Winds of Magic, storing daily-gathered magic within talisman paper. Though its release cannot be freely controlled, it remains a formidable boon.
True Form of the Yue Zhuo

Legend holds that 'Shadowdance' is a fragment of the Moon Empress's power. When the Black Jade Crow Warden heeds its call, he can commune with the Wind of Yin and transform into the divine Yue Zhuo bird.
The best way to counter a spellcaster is to sever the link between the Chaos sorcerer and the Winds of Magic.
As the enraged Jade Wrath Lion communes with the Winds of Magic, its devastating charge gains unmatched, overwhelming force.
Colossal bolts of lightning fire from the engine, and the hunting spear of the triceratops god descends from the heavens, carving furrows filled with shredded flesh.
Itza is the ancient sacred god of cold-blooded beasts; by operating the engine and casting arcane rites, even the wildest can be tamed.
Avatar of the Council Lord: Greed

Among the most fearsome forms the great horned rat can take is the Lord of Ruin, living catastrophes bringing destruction and desolation, born of the Realm of Chaos where devastation and slaughter reign.

Found the stronghold, guard the home, and drink deep with joyous laughter!
You'll never reach the other side, foul creature! This I swear upon my long beard!
For the glory of the mountains and our ancestors!
The forge burns bright, the hammer rings true, a peerless weapon now forged anew!
The thunder rune blazes with light, and in an instant thunder answers the call across the heavens, as if Grungni himself had brought down his anvil-hammer.
The great cannon roars, the smoke clears, and the mountains tremble to its song!
Slay the evil dragon, march into the wastes, and put every Chaos beast to the sword!
It has to be said, most of the Ogres' prey are quite dim-witted, but careless hunters often end up swapping roles with their quarry.
The tide of the great cataclysm once swept across the world, devouring all in its path; heroes arose so that heroes need never rise again.
The masterwork of the Old Ones stands on the brink of ruin, but what awaits the complacent foe?
Xhotec is the throne favoured by the sun god; the heat of the blazing sun stirs the fighting spirit of the warriors beneath it, restoring their vigor anew.
The mummy of the first Slann sits serenely, yet a violent gale of magic swirls around it, as the Lost speak in an obscure incantation two words: Utter Ruin.
The mysteries of the Winds of Magic, inscribed by Tepok himself along the paths of the miniature heavens, are enough to enlighten every master of magic.
The Tzunki crystal, steeped for millennia in a pool of emerald, can wrest the souls of valiant warriors back from the grasp of Chaos into the mortal realm.
At the will of the Great Star-Gazer, even celestial bodies may be guided, plummeting down upon the tide of foes.
Even a great work knows moments of neglect—rouse yourself!
While breath remains, no mercy is shown.
If mortal lives are but trickling streams, then we shall converge into an overwhelming, boundless flood.
The summoned ancestral spirits will, in the end, vanish gracefully from the warriors' sight...
In the Celestial Empire there lives a beast, shaped like a water buffalo, its fur black as lacquer, that chews iron and swallows bronze.
All things must find balance, just as darkness and light, moon and sun, male and female each find their counterpart.
The Heavenly Wind has abandoned these bodies and returned to the Dragon Emperor's palm — all is already too late...
The construct is severely damaged, broken limbs and wreckage scattered everywhere, and its bond with the Wind of Aethyr grows perilously unstable! But there must still be a way...
The construct has taken some damage, and its bond with the Wind of Aethyr begins to falter — turn the tide quickly!
The spirits see clearly, and weigh their own judgment.
Even amidst chaos, one resents that heaven shows no mercy.
Heaven gives birth to all things, nourishing every living being.
Heaven's timing rages with divine wrath, its merciless slaughter sweeping across the wilderness.
The soul of the Dragon of Khorne is bound to the eternal will of the Blood God, allowing it to breathe forth blood-flame drawn from the brazen abyss.
The one thing never in short supply on a battlefield is skulls and souls — when you need them, just hack them straight off the enemy's neck. What's that, you say spirit?
When this monster tears through its foes, all can clearly hear the bone-chilling, blood-curdling roar erupting from its throat.
Rivers of blood and mountains of corpses — to this instrument of slaughter in service of the Blood God, such is the finest sight the mortal world has to offer.
Scatter and flee, you cowards! Your flesh and blood are the finest fuel for this steel bull's rampage!
Eighth Legion! Turn your accumulated failures into the fury of the Blood Realm! Your freedom will come — but only once the Father God grants it!
Molten brass ceaselessly flows to seal the wounds upon the body; only warriors who serve Khorne with utter devotion may receive this blessing. As for that mad bull? Nothing but a reject.
The Liche King invokes dark magic amid the desert storm, and moments later, torn limbs and the dying whirl within its fury.
Heed this whisper from the underworld, for this god of the netherworld calls out its hunger for the souls above.
Favour of the Gods: Great Emperor of Nehekhara
The most noble gift of Ptra is the golden body and supreme might the undying Emperor has long coveted.

Asaph's blessing kindled the warrior queen's desire for vengeance, culminating in the cold bite carried upon her bowstring.
Hierotitan Avatar: Sky Hawk of the Mortuary Cult
Though the tomb high priest was cast into exile, the Mortuary Cult's contributions to Nehekhara earned him the favour of Tahoth.
The wrath of the goddess of vengeance guides the arrows of the Supreme Queen's legions; the serpent venom dripping from their heads is enough to soak the entire land.
The solitude and torment of exile taught the high priest that even the incantations of the gods carry their own dark side.
The Hierotitan becomes the guide of fallen kings' souls, dispelling the wicked spirits lurking in darkness and repelling the demons that would devour the wandering ghosts of the void.
Realm of Souls Bone Ostrich Rider
Valiant warriors awakened from the Realm of Souls ride upon massive ostrich skeletons, seeking the enemy's fatal weakness and delivering a deadly blow with wind-swift speed.
Those who dare disturb the slumber of kings shall face the wrath of ancient tyrant souls.
A tomb prince, buried in sand; grasping his game piece, transformed into a lion.
(Ancient Nehekharan) Soldiers, awaken! Slay all who trespass!
Soul bound to obsidian, wrathful flames surging skyward.
(Ancient Nehekharan) All who disturb my rest and refuse to kneel shall be buried here!
The divine avatar of Nehekhara's Great Emperor stands in disdainful majesty; none who dare gaze upon his imposing form can escape terror, frozen in place.
The lord of golden bones points to the sky, and the sun god's scorching beam answers, cleansing the enemy into a heap of ash.
In the name of the vulture god, an endless maritime storm and black vultures are summoned, subjecting the enemy to a baptism of raging winds, torrential rain, and terror.

Its scorching body carries all the pride and fury borne by the vast, long-suffering Motherland.
When the world was first forged, all things were surrounded by darkness and ice; like a generous and noble king, He shot flame through the sky to light the entire world.
'Death, like frost that pierces to the marrow; though the door be shut tight, it cannot be barred out. Even in the height of summer's bloom, we cannot escape the sorrow of ice and snow.'

'Death comes like frost seeping into the marrow; bar the door as you may, it cannot be kept out. Though midsummer's bloom return once more, none shall escape the ruin of ice and snow!'

Within its tranquil body lies all the pride and fury borne by the vast, long-suffering Motherland.
'The white bird gleams in solemn glory, casting off fear and care to soar to the heavens...'
Salyak is vital to this land; prayers to her come mostly from the mothers of warriors, but she will not save those whose time has already come.
Within its restless body lies all the pride and fury borne by the vast, long-suffering Motherland.
Tor's temple stands upon the mountain peak; when the storm comes, Tor unleashes his wrathful judgment amid thunder, lightning, and torrential rain.
'Thunder rends the vast sky as death descends, Tor's roaring bolt strikes the soul asunder!'
Within its frigid body lies all the pride and fury borne by the vast, long-suffering Motherland.
The Bear Father's bone-chilling roar rallies Kislev's warriors beneath his banner; their fates are forever intertwined, and the fate of the Motherland hangs upon that banner.
Rain of Blood from the Sky
The violent surge of dark magic triggers an explosion, wounding everyone nearby — though the caster too will find it difficult to command the Winds of Magic afterward.

Black Ark corsairs are natural predators of the sea's great beasts, using spikes, massive nets, grappling hooks, and barbed chains to capture, bind, or corner fleeing monsters before hacking them to pieces.
The witch summons a blood-filled pool through dark magic, dropping it down from the deck of the Black Ark. Its impact proves devastating, for the blood within is foul and corrosive.
The souls of countless slaves aboard the Black Ark are 'extracted' and hurled skyward by sorcery, crashing back down to earth like a lethal waterfall.
The serpent's heads gather all their magic and reduce to ash everything the Goddess of Magic despises.
You'll surely feel elated at having severed one of its heads! But dare you gaze upon this twisted creation, you will swiftly fall into nightmares of madness and delusion.
As the ravaged body of the Bound Hydra regenerates, it unleashes tremendous dark energy, and once restored, continues to devour all in its path.
The statue of Khaine thirsts to be bathed in blood, tormenting the souls trapped within it, and it will never tolerate cowardice or weakness.
We live in dark and trying times, and so the war-fury of Khaine shall be our guiding light.
The pitch-black soul of Malus Darkblade has been temporarily separated from that of the treacherous daemon Tzarkan — but this will not last long.
Should these mad witches clash with you in battle, no matter what arcane power fills your weapon, it will fall silent amid their shrieking wails.
A light touch may leave you numb all over, or utterly weakened — and if your luck is worse still, the victim can only watch as their heart is pierced through!
One of the many adaptations of the Deep Sea Dragon is its use of agony drawn from the abyss as a weapon against its prey.
The Blackguard Knights share their masters' bloodthirsty nature, their whips cracking with dreadful force, easily whipping the beasts into a furious, battle-ready frenzy.
The surging waves not only extinguish fires with ease but also conceal your form, and render the enemy unable to advance a single step.

The surging waves around the flagship not only extinguish nearby fires with ease but also render the enemy unable to advance a single step, while the towering watchtowers strip away any place for the enemy to hide.
The fallen heroes of Yvresse can return to the mortal world through the power of the waystone, clad in golden enchanted armor, their will and strength lighting the eternal mists.
The age of dragons has long passed, but the pride of the Caledorians has never dimmed. The flames that once raged upon the peaks now rage within every Caledorian elf.
The Flying Fish employs an almost miraculous hunting method, adjusting the burst of stored icy water according to the size and distance of its target, letting its prey drown in the depths of the sea.
Once the Sky Cutters have seized aerial supremacy, they can use their bolt throwers to scatter the enemy, then swiftly deliver ammunition to the allies who need it most.
The power of Kurnous flows through their veins, and they serve directly under the Lord of All Forests, riding forth upon the Wild Hunt.
To sacrifice oneself to Morai-Heg is a dark path requiring immense suffering to endure, but when the end draws near, exceptions must be made — someone must bear this burden.
These pale blue magical longbows absorb the malice gathered by their wielders, empowering them in turn and giving rise to arrows of even greater dread — though they have no effect on allies.
Surely you have seen a towering wall in your dreams — a green hell coated in venom and thorns, one you would never wish to approach.
Transcendent and stern of countenance, they strike down the enemy in the name of the Lord of Forests and Beasts.
Graceful as a flawless dancer, its movements defy prediction—suddenly, a twisted branch pierces through your heart from behind.
The unyielding spirit of the white birch waits for all dormant things to be reborn from the ashes, when the demigod shall awaken from the Oak of Ages and sound the horn of the Wild Hunt.
Nature answers Orion's call, raining down a torrent of arrows upon any foe who dares defile Athel Loren.
As the natural world continues to wither, Ariel grows ever more warlike, allowing her perilous moth form to endure.

The branches of the ancient oak fall to the ground, and dryads are reborn from the flames, their souls holding unwavering devotion to Athel Loren; there is no room for negotiation with the enemy, only death.
Spring has come to Athel Loren; the reawakened ancient spirits nourish the living, and the lines of Asrai shall stand as firm as the roots of an ancient tree.
The unyielding spirit of the poplar snaps its own charred branches, wrapping them with lightning to forge new war arrows—this pain must be healed with the bones of the enemy.
This spell summons twisted, gnarled branches from the ground, tightly ensnaring the enemy and choking the life from them.
Sharp metal spikes twisted into shape to ensure a point always faces upward.
A simple explosive device disguised as a dwarf shield.
Sharp metal spikes twisted into shape to ensure a point always faces upward.
The bombs equipped on the "Thunderbarge" are even larger than those on the "Bomber." If multiple bombs strike their intended target, the result will be truly explosive!
Power of the Five Elements Compass
The Dragon's Keen Eye, sharp and bright, blazing with radiance, sees through all things.
The Dragon's Valor, mighty and fearless, resolute and unyielding, undaunted in the face of peril.
The Dragon's Ferocity, blazing like roaring flame, soaring in spirit, fearing nothing.
The Dragon's Tenacity, immovable as a mountain, eternal and unchanging, steadfast and unbending.
A deafening volley of fire lances, shattering heaven and earth alike.
The three axe strokes carry boundless power, yet once spent, there is nothing left to give.
Harness the power of heaven and earth within the Five Elements Compass, for the mage's use.
When the wind strikes the Tuo Drums, the mountains and rivers shake; lightning flashes above the banners, reaching sun and moon.
Though unable to take the form of a true dragon, one can still awaken its might.
Though unable to take the form of a true dragon, one can still awaken its might.
Golden helm, golden armor, cinnabar robe; purple eyes, crimson brows, and verdant mane.
The souls of our Celestial warriors shall be claimed by Heaven itself—how could we allow the foul Daemons of Tzeentch to defile them?
The storm took my dearest friend from me; the lightning roused me from death. I clawed my way out of agony, becoming the thunder that sweeps across the night!

Arcs of electricity occasionally crackle from the scars on Halfdan's chest, bursting into dazzling sparks whenever he cracks open an enemy's skull, healing Tor's chosen one's wounds and staving off exhaustion.
The blood-soaked Son of Tor raises his war hammer high, and the sky's furious lightning howls down from above, cleansing the wicked creatures that dare defile the Motherland's borders.

This great hammer moves as freely in Gu Kahn's hands as an extension of his own limbs; a single casual blow can crush warm-bloods and their so-called fine armor together with their flesh into a single mangled mass.
Sharp, heavy, and imbued with the wild blessing of the beast god Itza, this great axe—honed by countless spirit-lizard craftsmen—can behead even the thickest-necked carnosaur in a single blow.
Assembled from the proudest trophies of Gu Ke Jia's kills, this thick carapace, able to withstand the heat of the Solar Engine, renders bullets and arrows nothing more than an itch.
Devastating warp lightning brews within the twisted flesh, capable of piercing even the sturdiest armor.
The depletion of warpstone energy means the flames are about to die out, but these furless things will feel a real explosion, oh yes! Oh yes!
Ugh, however they made this stuff, the Gnoblars sure perk right up after drinking it!
Careful when you're picking up this little snack, boss — I got pricked by it last time.
The butcher tosses chilled cuts of meat into the boiling cauldron, and as the savory broth is downed one after another, the surrounding Ogres gain extraordinary regenerative power.
If we ain't got proper shot, just smash up whatever scrap metal we got and stuff it down the barrel!
Onward to the River of Souls, to serve the ancestral spirits; ten thousand banners stir as they cross to the other shore.
Unfurl the great wings woven from tormented souls, and scatter Death's blessing from the sky!
The domain of the goddess Asaph brooks no trespass; the sandstorm is her punishment for those who offend her!
The great Soul River Dark Turtle guards the resting place of Cathay's fallen heroes; while its dark shell holds firm, it remains unbreakable and impregnable.
Its body has guarded the Dragon God for a thousand years, and the vast gates of heaven itself shall not be breached.
Mark of the Bin Iron Armour
Mirror of the Cassia Soul - Moonlight
Candlelight burns the heavens, flames scorching the southern lands; the wrath of the fire dragon is unstoppable.
The Dragon Emperor's majesty overawes the eight wildernesses; myriad armies bow in reverence, and all evils lie hidden in fear.
The Raging Gale shakes the wilds, arrows falling like rain; the Long Wall stands ever vigilant, shafts loosed swift as wind.
The Soul Abyss hides its form, leaving no trace; ghostly spirits guard the body, untouched by ten thousand arrows.
The Dark Abyss rides the wind, treading upon the waves; crossing forests and fording waters as if walking level ground.
Jade Heaven holds to balance, offense and defense as one; upholding the law with equity, favoring neither side.
Moonlight condenses the soul, its magic boundless; the Yin arts shield the body, and no evil can intrude.
The Bin Iron Armor, forged a hundred times over, is unbreakable; western arts of casting shape a body of gold.
Hong Ying weaves a bridge of shadow, allowing him to move freely across the battlefield and summon a terrifying dark abyss at his destination.
My body may perish, but my resolve shall never fade.
None command the Wind of Ji Lun as masterfully as the Jade Blood Taoists, who teach their swordsman disciples to carry this power onto the battlefield.
Created by Jade Blood Taoists fusing vampiric sorcery with Xi Zhao alchemy, this elixir flows like liquid jade, bearing both the power to restore life and to corrode with insidious poison.
The green wind is stored in the mystic vault, its spirit eternal and ever-flourishing.
Withered bones drink the jade dew, and dead wood sprouts anew.
Vitality hides within the smallest space, its cycle never exhausted.

Special vines native to the southern frontier are repeatedly soaked and sun-dried before being woven into light yet sturdy armor — though the material carries the fatal flaw of being highly flammable.
Born of myth and tempered by the sea, the Dragonblade turns the might of the dragonship into a keen edge, its brilliance striking more fear into enemies than true steel.
The dragonship's sails gleam like dawn reflected on the sea; the enchanted canvas grants the fleet extraordinary speed and vision as they patrol the world's oceans.
Scaled jaws snap fiercely at the High Elves' enemies, dragging the shrieking prey down into the abyss where the barnacled serpent lurks.
Though miniature versions of sea elementals, Pure Water Spirits are no less terrifying, unleashing horrifying power once their wrath is stirred.
The crew of the High Elf fleet are experienced sailors, often standing alongside the Sea Guard on land when manpower runs short.
The mirror's light shines forth, and nothing can escape its gaze!
The mirror's light shines forth, and as the moonlight rises higher, nothing can escape its gaze!
Whether arrows, blades, fangs, or claws, the divine dragon statue coiled about the beast holds nothing but bone-deep contempt for such crude methods of slaughter.
The dragon soars through the heavens, its might striking terror; the dragon battles upon the wilds, its blood staining the earth black and gold.
We walk within the shadows, vanishing before the light of dawn.
The body heat of the Volcanic Spinebeast is enough to ignite even the dampest rainforest. When it unleashes its heat fully, everything nearby can be set ablaze in an instant.
March like the wind, swift beyond reach.
Form ranks like a dense forest, impervious to the enemy.
Attack like fire, spreading like a wildfire unchecked.
Stand immovable, unbreakable by any force.
Dark clouds veil the moon, coming and going without a trace.
Strike like thunder's mighty crash, shattering the enemy to dust.
